newsitem.title: USA: Patina Oil amends credit pact, sees savings.
newsitem.headline: Patina Oil amends credit pact, sees savings.

text.p: Patina Oil & Gas Corp said Tuesday that it had absorbed one of its subsidiaries and entered into an amended bank credit agreement.
Patina said the new credit agreement with its banks cuts the interest rate on its borrowings and revises various covenants to provide additional financial flexibility.
The company said it expects to save more than $250,000 annually under the revised terms.

The company said the merger of Gerrity Oil & Gas into Patina represents part of the ongoing simplification of Patina's structure, adding that it has assumed all Gerrity's assets and liabilities, including the 11-3/4 percent subordinated notes.
